label: GO step, choosing a2, in the last ~10 trials of the episode
explanation: Fires only at GO steps (100% of mass), and only when the agent is choosing a2 (model_act == 2; almost no activation for a1). It is strongly tied to the episode clock: 89% of mass is in episode trials 90-99, with a smaller cluster in trials 0-19 (about 9% of mass) and nothing in trials 20-79. That matches its link to low value output (91% of mass where value < 5.22, which is the end of the episode). Inside the late-episode a2 GO steps, magnitude rises with ep_trial and is higher when the previous trial was also a2 and rewarded (adding prev_reward==1 raises precision from 0.43 to 0.56 but loses recall). It does not fire at D1 or D2, or on a1 choices. Precision is only about 0.43 because many late-episode a2 GO steps stay below threshold, so recording partially_explained. I used model_act (the agent own policy output at GO) in place of the FUTURE action variable; both give the same score.
